ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF FEBRUARY 9, 2016.
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of February 9, 2016.
A-1 Minutes 2-9-16 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF AN AMENDMENT TO RESOLUTION NO. 06-4516 AND RESOLUTION NO. 15-5191 TO ESTABLISH REVISIONS TO FEES FOR PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT PERMITS
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5265 to amend the City's schedule of rates, fees and other charges for planning and development permits.
B-1 Planning & Development Fees Staff Report
B-1 Planning & Development Fees Attachment A Resolution
B-1 Planning & Development Fees Attachment B Survey
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL - None
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1402
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 16-5264 approving Warrant Register No. 1402.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1402
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK AND STREET USE AGREEMENT WITH LA PUENTE NATIONAL LITTLE LEAGUE NON-PROFIT FOR A CARNIVAL AND PARADE
It is recommended that the City Council approve the Park and Streets Use Agreement for the Youth Coalition Carnival and parade.
D-2 Park and Street Use Agreement Staff Report
D-2 Park and Street Use Agreement Attachment A Agreement
D-3
CONSIDERATION AND APPROVAL OF A LICENSE AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY AND FORTY-FIVE PROPERTY OWNERS ALONG VALLEY BOULEVARD TO IMPLEMENT PHASE III OF THE VALLEY BOULEVARD WALL IMPROVEMENT PROJECT
It is recommended that the City Council approve the License Agreement as to form and authorize the Mayor to execute the License Agreement with each of the 45 property owners.
D-3 Valley Boulevard License Agreement Staff Report
D-3 License Agreement Valley Wall Attachment A
D-4
SECOND READING OF ORDINANCE 16-938 ADDING CHAPTER 3.76 (SHOPPING CART REGULATIONS) TO TITLE 3 (PUBLIC SAFETY AND MORALS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 16-938 an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Adding Chapter 3.76 (Shopping Cart Regulations) To Title 3 (Public Safety and Morals) of the La Puente Municipal Code.
D-4 Shopping Cart Staff Report
D-4 Shopping Cart Attachment A Ordinance
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION OF A LETTER OF SUPPORT FOR THE PROPOSED LOS ANGELES COUNTY PHARMACEUTICALS AND SHARPS COLLECTION AND DISPOSAL STEWARDSHIP ORDINANCE
It is recommended that the City Council approve a letter of support for the proposed Los Angeles County Pharmaceuticals and Sharps Collection and Disposal Stewardship Ordinance.
E-1 Pharm and Sharps Disposal Staff Report
E-1 Pharm and Sharps Disposal Attachment A Letter of Support
E-1 Pharm and Sharps Disposal Attachment B Request and Outline

Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.

AB 1234 REPORTS

ADJOURNMENT
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION

Dated this this 18th day of February, 2016
